steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Power rule: d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹ for all real n

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Find the stationary points of y = x^3 - 3x^2 - 9x + 5 and determine their nature --- Solution: y' = 3x^2 - 6x - 9 = 3(x^2 - 2x - 3) = 3(x-3)(x+1) = 0 -> x = 3 or x = -1. y'' = 6x - 6. At x = 3: y'' = 12 > 0 -> minimum at (3, -22). At x = -1: y'' = -12 < 0 -> maximum at (-1, 10)
